title: GIG-3323: Resolve Hydra Dump From Older Stamp Folders
description: Walks dated Spaces stamp folders newest-first so Hydra produce uses the latest dump that exists instead of failing when the newest Forge folder has no hydra_prod.sql.gz.

test_plan.description: Resolver uses an older stamp when the newest folder lacks the dump
steps: After release, dispatch factory produce and confirm Hydra starts from a dated folder that contains hydra_prod.sql.gz
